title: requirements.json — everything the engineer's intent document requires, one row each
description: Transcribed from brainstorm.md by specification's Wave 1a, one row per atomic proposition, in the engineer's words. Downstream stages bind this file; brainstorm.md is read by nobody after this stage. Scripts act on id, judge and target; verbatim and note are text they carry through unparsed.

id.description: Unique in this file, in document order. check-hints and design documents refer to it; it never changes once written.

verbatim.description: The engineer's own words, trimmed to the clause, original language. Every later reader is held to this wording.

judge.description: Who establishes that this holds. A stage name (the eight are rules.FORWARD_PRIORITY): that stage's artifact or run is the evidence and that stage reads this row. specification: one of its own sidecar entries, a clock, a port, a cut edge, an SDC statement. simulation: a testbench observes it or a coverage report measures it. rtl-design: only reading the RTL establishes it. lint-cdc, synthesis, timing-analysis, power-analysis: the tool's report. simulation-plan: the plan itself must contain it. human: a person decides at the specification gate from the documents available there. outside: something the pipeline does not run establishes it; the pipeline does not claim it. none: nothing to establish, a delegation, a scoping statement, background. unassignable: you could not decide; say why in note; finalize refuses the file until a human resolves it.

target.description: Only when the engineer's bound is in a unit the judging stage's tool reports natively; the stage's script then compares. Any other unit stays in verbatim and the stage's reader judges it. synthesis: area_um2, timing_slack_ns. power-analysis: power_mw, optionally per scenario. simulation: coverage_line, coverage_cond, coverage_fsm, coverage_toggle in percent.

op.description: The engineer's comparison, transcribed: actual op value must hold.

scenario.description: power_mw only: present when the engineer's bound names a power scenario.

note.description: Free text when a row needs one: the reason a judge could not be assigned, or which earlier row this one restates.
